note: Format v0, approved 2026-08-27 (design discussion: https://github.com/curtisgalloway/oxbox/issues/10). ox resolves venue against its own table; base_url is documentation and is never honored. cost 'unknown' or omitted behaves as paid. No entry carries params.max_tokens this issue: every class-A completion cap is at or above the 100,000 default (minimax-m3:free 943,718; glm-5.3-flash 131,072), and class-B venues publish no caps.

recommendations.why: Run-backed: 13 of 15 findings real over two batches on 2026-08-29, 7 of 12 on a matched batch on 2026-08-30 including the cross-host redirect in oxbox's own exposure gate, fixed the same afternoon. Budget for reasoning: 98% of its completion tokens across seven runs went to thinking, and one run used 84% of the 100,000 default.

The revealed Ox Alpha: 63 findings at 72% in edition 0.2 and a real credential leak found in oxbox itself. Nobody has run the paid route; same weights per the reveal, same served behavior is an assumption.

One run on 2026-08-30: 2 of 10 findings real on a payload matched to MiniMax M3, with the one serious defect filed as UNCERTAIN and a false one filed as critical. Cheap, fast and format-clean; run it on a different fixture before trusting its severity labels.
